title: Introduce proactive utilization-forecast ledger and autoscaler advisory
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a new throughput ledger service and a predictive utilization advisory for Dedicated fleets. Improves autoscaler decisioning and tenant-level telemetry; no customer-facing API changes. Opt-in via dedicated controller flag.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers operating large Dedicated fleets reported repeat SLA degradations when correlated microbursts exceeded short-term commitments and the autoscaler reacted too late. Existing warm-pool and reservation systems are reactive and misallocate capacity during multi-tenant surge windows. This change introduces a lightweight in-cluster "Throughput Ledger" plus a proactive utilization forecast advisory that feeds the autoscaler to smooth allocations and reduce reactive provisioning spikes.

What this PR does (high-level):
- Introduces pkg/ledger: a time-windowed ledger that tracks tenant contractual throughput, committed percentiles, and a short-horizon forecast score. Ledger entries are compact (slotted counters + EWMA for slope).
- Adds a controller (cmd/controller/ledger_advisor.go) that periodically polls the ledger and exposes an advisory API to the autoscaler. The advisory contains recommended soft-reservation deltas and a confidence score.
- Extends telemetry/metrics to export per-tenant forecast_score, forecast_horizon_seconds, and adjustment_recommendation gauge/labels so SRE and customers can observe predicted pressure before autoscaler actions.
- Integrates advisory into the Dedicated autoscaler decision path: when forecast_score > threshold and reserved headroom < recommended, autoscaler will pre-warm up to the recommended delta (bounded by burst_budget).
- Adds an opt-in feature flag (--enable-proactive-ledger) to avoid behavior changes for customers who don't want predictive actions immediately.

Design notes and reasoning:
- Forecasting approach: we prioritized safety and explainability over ML complexity. The forecast uses rhythmic slope detection (EWMA on recent token/sec), a lightweight seasonality score (time-of-day weighting per tenant), and a decay window to produce a forecast_score in [0,1]. The ledger stores committed_percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for cross-checking against forecasted demand to avoid unnecessary warmups.
- Failure modes: advisory is advisory — when a forecast is erroneous the autoscaler will not exceed burst_budget or reservation caps. Telemetry includes a post-hoc correction metric (forecast_error_ratio) to track calibration and disable proactively if error rate is high.
- Performance: ledger operations are designed to be O(1) per request by updating slotted counters; memory overhead estimated ~200 bytes/tenant for 1M tenants (sparse).

Commits (summary):
- commit c3f7b9d: initial ledger core implementation (pkg/ledger) with slotted counters and EWMA slope.
- commit a8b2e1f: controller + advisory API and CLI feature flag.
- commit 4bf12d2: autoscaler integration and safety checks (burst budget bounding).
- commit e9a4c77: telemetry metrics, Prometheus exporter and Grafana dashboard scaffolding (observability/forecasting.json).
- commit 5d1f90a: unit/e2e tests for forecast calibration and autoscaler behavior, test fixtures for synthetic multi-tenant bursts.
- commit b24f7ec: docs (docs/ops/dedicated/proactive-ledger.md) and helm chart values change (charts/dedicated/values.yaml) to expose the feature flag.

Files changed (high level):
- pkg/ledger/ledger.go (new): core ledger implementation, slotted counters, EWMA slope, percentile aggregator.
- cmd/controller/ledger_advisor.go (new): periodic advisory loop and HTTP/gRPC endpoint used by autoscaler.
- controller/autoscaler/decision.go (modified): pulls advisory, applies bounded prewarm recommendations.
- telemetry/metrics.go (modified): new metrics and labels for forecast scoring.
- observability/dashboards/forecasting.json (new): initial dashboard to visualize forecast vs actual.
- charts/dedicated/values.yaml (modified): new flag enableProactiveLedger: false.
- docs/ops/dedicated/proactive-ledger.md (new): operator runbook and safe rollout steps.
- test/e2e/forecast_sim.go (new): synthetic burst simulator for regression tests.

Illustrative snippet (ledger update):
```
// called for each token batch completion
ledger.SlotAdd(tenantID, int64(tokens))
ledger.UpdateEWMA(tenantID, float64(tokens)/elapsed.Seconds())
```

Review conversation (highlights):
- Rajat Singh (reviewer): "Nice separation between ledger and autoscaler. Two asks: 1) add a safety cutoff when cluster-wide prewarm would exceed budget, 2) ensure the ledger snapshotting is crash-safe."
- Maya Chen (author): "Addressed both: cluster budget check added to decision.go and snapshotting implemented with compact checkpoint files in pkg/ledger/checkpoint.go. Tests added to validate restart behavior."
- Elena Park (reviewer): "Can we add an integration test showing a false-positive forecast and that autoscaler doesn't overcommit?"
- Maya Chen: "Added test/e2e/forecast_false_positive_test in this PR; asserts forecast_error_ratio threshold prevents automatic prewarm after repeated false positives."
- Jonah Morales (approver): "Telemetry labels look good; please run a canary in staging with the feature flag disabled by default."

CI summary: unit tests passed (172s), linter passed, formatting checks passed. Initial e2e run showed a flaky test (test/e2e/forecast_sim.go) failing due to timing; reran with extended timeout and passed. Load test (optional) was queued and green on second try.

Rollout and runbook:
- Default: feature flag off. Operators must flip enableProactiveLedger on per-cluster via helm values.
- Canary: enable for 5% of dedicated nodes/pools for 48 hours, monitor forecast_error_ratio, forecast_horizon_seconds, and post_warm_latency impact.
- Auto-disable: controller will automatically disable proactive actions for a tenant if forecast_error_ratio > 0.35 over 1h.

Observability and SLO impacts:
- New metrics allow alerting on rising forecast scores across many tenants which has historically preceded SLA slippage. This PR should reduce reactive provisioning-induced latency spikes and improve sustained throughput SLO by smoothing prewarming. No immediate change to user-facing latency guarantees until the operator enables feature.

Open items and follow-ups (tracked as ENG-4821):
- Tune forecast parameters using 30d production traces (next sprint).
- Explore an optional ML-backed forecast model behind a feature flag if EWMA approach proves insufficient.
- Add a per-tenant opt-out API for customers who want absolute strict reservation enforcement.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main after approvals by Jonah Morales and green CI. Changelog and operator docs added.

If you want to run the canary in staging I can provide a helm values snippet and a quick kubectl runbook for enabling the controller flag.
